title: arctostaphylos tomentosa var. tomentosiformis
intro: Arctostaphylos tomentosa var. tomentosiformis, commonly known as Island Woolly Monkey Flower, is a rare and endangered plant species native to the Channel Islands of California. It is a shrub in the heath family (Ericaceae) that has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Island Woolly Monkey Flower include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
